title: Tara Chklovski (CEO, Technovation) — Incorruptible is 'just what the world needs right now. A bright light'
summary: Tara Chklovski — founder and CEO of Technovation — publishes a Builder's Room lead-up post that stands on its own as an endorsement: after The Lean Startup 'changed the game,' Incorruptible is the book the world needs right now — one that says each of our actions makes a difference, even in the big financial markets, and that we can make a lot of money AND help humans flourish.
blockquote: Now his second book, Incorruptible, is just what the world needs right now. A bright light that says each of our actions makes a difference — yes even on the big, important financial markets. And we can make a lot of money — AND — help humans flourish.
